name: sleep_episodic_replay
hypothesis: If episodic pairs are replayed during idle sleep, then high-confidence rehearsed pairs will graduate to the concept graph as typed edges, increasing the graph's episodic edge count without crashing.
analysis_plan: Verify that (a) at least one non-user_fact pair graduates to a graph edge with relation_type='episodic', (b) user_fact pairs are withheld (not drained to world graph), (c) empty binder does not crash. This is a structural/behavioral test, not a statistical comparison.
related_backlog_task: Add sleep-phase replay: consolidate episodic -> semantic during idle
